Higher Education Committee
Tuesday, March 5, 2024
3:00 PM, G-15 Capitol

Minutes

Present: Senator Omar Fateh - Chair, Senator Aric Putnam Vice Chair, Senator Zach Duckworth, Senator Robert D. Farnsworth,
Senator Robert J. Kupec, Senator Erin P. Murphy, Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Jason Rarick

Absent: No Members Absent

Senator Omar Fateh called the meeting to order at 3:00pm
S.F. 1275: Senator Duckworth: FAFSA or state financial aid application high school students completion

requirement; Office of Higher Education and Department of Education
commissioners establishment of a FAFSA working group requirement.

Senator Duckworth moved that S.F. 1275, be recommended to pass and re-referred to the Education Policy Committee.

S.F. 3364: Senator Hoffman: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) research and caregiver support programs
grant appropriation.

Senator Fateh moved that S.F. 3364, be laid over.

S.F. 4226: Senator Putnam: Workforce development scholarships program eligibility expansion provision.

Senator Putnam moved that S.F. 4226, be laid over.

Call to order

The meeting was adjourned at 4:49pm
